text: Free demo: you're a pirate cannon, and everything on the enemy deck is about to become flying debris.
Aim, fire, and sink their ship.
Every wreck pays cash for upgrades, like shockwaves and a whole lot more cannonballs.
Best part: knocking down a giant tower of tin cans and watching every single one tumble.
Explosive barrels help with the heavy stuff.
The catch? In the trailer, the explosions have no sound effects. Just a sea shanty.
The demo is about six hundred megabytes, English only.
Think Angry Birds in 3D, on the open sea.
Worth a dip for five minutes of pure destruction.
